'''Sidy Cissoko''' (born April 2, 2004) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[NBA G League Ignite]] of the [[NBA G League]].

==Early life==
Cissoko's father, [[Yaya Cissokho|Yaya]] (or Yakia), was a basketball player who represented Senegal at the [[1980 Summer Olympics]] in [[Moscow]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202210300077.html|title=Basketball - Babacar Sané is getting closer to the NBA|work=[[Sud Quotidien]]|date=October 29, 2022|access-date=April 23, 2022|language=fr|via=[[AllAfrica]]}}</ref> Growing up in France, Sidy played basketball from a young age and looked up to [[Kyrie Irving]], seeing as he was shorter than the rest of his teammates at the time.<ref name="relevo">{{cite news|url=https://www.relevo.com/baloncesto/nba/sidy-cissoko-baskonia-rumbo-creo-20230329121805-nt.html|title=Sidy Cissoko, un ex de Baskonia rumbo a la NBA: "Creo que no iré al Mundial, me presento al draft"|work=[[Relevo]]|first=Noelia|last=Gómez Mira|date=March 29, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref> He reached the under-15 level with CTC Center Essonne.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mr-stats.frenchbasketballscouting.fr/joueur/cissoko-sidy-9978|title=Toutes les saisons du joueur CISSOKO Sidy|publisher=frenchbasketballscouting.fr|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=fr}}</ref>

In 2017, at 13 years of age, Cissoko moved to Spain and joined the youth ranks of [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]].<ref name="relevo1">{{cite news|url=https://www.relevo.com/baloncesto/nba/junio-2022-febrero-2023-allstar-20230201174255-nt.html|title=Cómo pasar en ocho meses de la LEB Oro al All-Star de la NBA: la proeza de Sidy Cissoko|work=[[Relevo]]|first=Noelia|last=Gómez Mira|date=February 1, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.noticiasdealava.eus/baskonia/2023/03/29/sidy-cissoko-presentara-proximo-draft-6626511.html|title=Sidy Cissoko se presentará al próximo draft de la NBA|work=Noticias de Álava|first=Oscar|last=San Martín|date=March 29, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref> In [[2020–21 Liga EBA season|2020–21]], Cissoko played with the [[Saski Baskonia B|Baskonia reserves]] in the fourth-tier [[Liga EBA]] and averaged a team-leading 17.4 points per game.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://baloncestoenvivo.feb.es/estadisticasacumuladas/848224|title=Baskonia {{!}} Liga EBA 2020/2021|publisher=[[Spanish Basketball Federation]]|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.noticiasdealava.eus/baskonia/2021/07/27/canterano-sidy-cissoko-ira-cedido-1092000.html|title=El canterano Sidy Cissoko también se irá cedido al Iraurgi|work=Noticias de Álava|first=Oscar|last=San Martín|date=July 27, 2021|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref> He also led the Baskonia junior (under-18) team to a fourth-place finish in the junior national championship while leading the competition in points and assists.<ref name=relevo1/>

==Professional career==
Cissoko was called up to the Baskonia first team ahead of the [[2021–22 ACB season]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://baskonia.elcorreo.com/jovenes-hanzlik-savkov-20210816132027-nt.html|title=Los jóvenes Hanzlik, Savkov y Cissoko harán la pretemporada con el Baskonia|work=[[El Correo]]|first=Jon|last=Aroca|date=August 16, 2021|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref> On September 26, 2021, Cissoko made his senior debut for Baskonia at the age of 17, playing 28 seconds in a 72–61 loss to [[Club Joventut Badalona|Joventut Badalona]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.acb.com/partido/cronica/id/102943|title=Triunfo de prestigio del Joventut frente al Baskonia (72-61)|publisher=[[Liga ACB]]|date=September 26, 2021|access-date=April 22, 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.baskonistas.com/sidy-cissoko-debuto-con-el-baskonia-en-badalona/|title=Sidy Cissoko debutó con el Baskonia en Badalona|work=Baskonistas|first=Ruben|last=Gazapo Ramos|date=September 27, 2021|access-date=April 22, 2023|language=es}}</ref> This allowed Baskonia to retain his European rights.<ref name="mundo">{{cite news|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/baloncesto/nba/20220720/1001839414/leb-oro-g-league-sidy-cissoko-opta-nueva-formativa-nba-ignite-draft.html|title=De la LEB Oro a la G-League: Sidy Cissoko opta por la nueva vía formativa de la NBA|work=[[Mundo Deportivo]]|first=Guille|last=Álvarez|date=July 20, 2022|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref>

A few days after his debut, Cissoko was loaned out to Baskonia's satellite club, [[Iraurgi SB]], in the second-tier [[LEB Oro]].<ref name="feb">{{cite news|url=https://www.feb.es/2022/7/10/baloncesto/202122-energia-azpeitiarra-llego-mano-del-talentoso-escolta-sidy-cissoko/90752.aspx|title=2021/22: La energía azpeitiarra llegó de la mano del talentoso escolta Sidy Cissoko|publisher=[[Spanish Basketball Federation]]|first=Pablo|last=Romero|date=July 10, 2022|access-date=April 23, 2023|language=es}}</ref> He averaged 10.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, and 2.4 assists in 32 games played.<ref name=mundo/><ref name=feb/> Cissoko trained with the Baskonia first team as well; he later said he learned a lot from watching [[Wade Baldwin IV]].<ref name=relevo/>

Cissoko was invited to play in the 2022 [[Nike Hoop Summit]] in [[Portland, Oregon]], recording three points, seven rebounds, four assists, and three steals in 23 minutes for the World Team in a 102–80 loss to Team USA.<ref name=relevo1/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.usab.com/history/nike-hoop-summit/xxiii-annual-nike-hoop-summit-2022.aspx|title=XXIII Annual Nike Hoop Summit -- 2022|publisher=[[USA Basketball]]|date=April 11, 2022|access-date=April 22, 2023}}</ref>

===NBA G League Ignite (2022–present)===
On July 19, 2022, it was announced that Cissoko had signed with the [[NBA G League Ignite]], a developmental team affiliated with the [[NBA G League]].<ref name="espn">{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/34268438/nba-draft-prospect-sidy-cissoko-signs-g-league-ignite-program|title=NBA draft prospect Sidy Cissoko signs with G League Ignite program|work=[[ESPN]]|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|date=July 19, 2022|access-date=April 22, 2023}}</ref> Cissoko became the first European player to sign with the Ignite.<ref name=mundo/> He pointed to the success of [[2022 NBA draft|2022]] lottery pick, [[Dyson Daniels]], who played at the [[NBA Global Academy]] in Australia before spending the [[2021–22 NBA G League season|2021–22 season]] with the Ignite.<ref name=espn/> At the time of his signing, Cissoko was ranked as the third-best European prospect in his class by Jonathan Givony of [[ESPN]], behind countrymen [[Victor Wembanyama]] and [[Rayan Rupert]].<ref name=espn/>

Cissoko was one of four Ignite players chosen to compete in the [[Rising Stars Challenge]] at the [[2023 NBA All-Star Game#Rising Stars Challenge|2023 NBA All-Star Weekend]], recording one rebound, one assist, and one steal for Team Jason in a 40–32 loss to Team Joakim.<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://ignite.gleague.nba.com/all-star|title=Ignite Set For Exciting NBA All-Star 2023 Slate|publisher=[[NBA G League Ignite]]|date=February 7, 2023|access-date=April 22, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230209204414/https://ignite.gleague.nba.com/all-star|archive-date=February 9, 2023|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://therookiewire.usatoday.com/lists/2023-nba-rising-stars-jose-alvarado-mvp/|title=NBA Rising Stars: Jose Alvarado named MVP to lead Team Pau to title|work=Rookie Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|first=Cody|last=Taylor|date=February 17, 2023|access-date=April 22, 2023}}</ref> He was also one of 24 players named to the G League's inaugural Next Up Game.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.deseret.com/2023/2/7/23590240/neemias-queta-frank-jackson-scoot-henderson-g-league-next-up-game|title=Neemias Queta, Frank Jackson and Scoot Henderson selected to play in G League Next Up Game|work=[[Deseret News]]|first=Joe|last=Coles|date=February 7, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref>

On January 16, 2023, Cissoko scored a then-season-high 21 points in a 141–119 defeat to the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]].<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://gleague.nba.com/game/fwn-vs-gli-2022200126?view=game-story|title=Mad Ants Use Big First Quarter To Top Ignite|publisher=[[NBA G League]]|date=January 16, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref> In another loss to the Mad Ants the following day, he scored 20 points on 8-of-10 shooting, including 4-of-5 from three.<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://gleague.nba.com/game/fwn-vs-gli-2022200132?view=game-story|title=Mad Ants Hold Off Late Ignite Rally For Sweep|publisher=[[NBA G League]]|date=January 17, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref> Cissoko had five straight games of 20 or more points in February and March.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://hoopshype.com/lists/nba-mock-draft-brandon-miller-scoot-henderson-cam-whitmore/|title=2023 Aggregate NBA Mock Draft: Scoot Henderson stays at No. 2, Cam Whitmore moving up|work=HoopsHype|first=Michael|last=Scotto|date=March 18, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref> This included a season-high 24 point-performance, along with six rebounds and four assists, in a 123–97 loss to the [[Memphis Hustle]] on February 24.<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://ignite.gleague.nba.com/news/ignite-defeated-by-hustle-123-97|title=Ignite Defeated By Hustle, 123-97|publisher=[[NBA G League Ignite]]|date=February 24, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref> Cissoko tied his season-high with 24 points against the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]] on March 15.<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://gleague.nba.com/game/sxf-vs-gli-2022200415?view=game-story|title=Ignite Falls Short in Hard-Fought Battle Against Skyforce|publisher=[[NBA G League]]|date=March 15, 2023|access-date=April 23, 2023}}</ref>

On March 29, 2023, Cissoko announced he was entering his named in the [[2023 NBA draft]].<ref name=relevo/>

==National team career==
Cissoko played for the [[France men's national under-19 basketball team|France national under-18 team]] at the [[2021 FIBA U18 European Challengers]]. He averaged 7.8 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.0 assists, and 2.4 steals per game. At the [[2022 FIBA U18 European Championship]] the following year, Cissoko averaged 11.3 points, 4.9 rebounds, 3.1 assists, and 2.4 steals per game.
